extensionDescription.message: Lists embedded PDF attachments beside the Edge viewer and opens them with their associated Windows application.

openPdfHint.message: Open a PDF in the usual Edge viewer.

networkSetupHelp.message: Set up the included Windows helper once and allow network access. The sidebar will then inspect the current network PDF automatically.

helpSave.message: “Prepare” saves a copy of the selected attachment in the “PDF-Anhaenge” subfolder of your Downloads folder. “Open” then opens the file with its associated Windows application.

helpOpen.message: The second click is needed because Edge only allows a file to be opened as a direct user action. Depending on your Edge settings, an additional prompt may appear.

helpLocal.message: For local PDFs, enable “Allow access to file URLs” for this extension at edge://extensions. Alternatively, use “Choose PDF”.

helpNetwork.message: For network shares, also install the Windows helper once and allow the optional Windows connection using “Enable network access”. The helper only reads network PDFs and does not modify any files.

helpPortals.message: For portals with one-time links or PDFs embedded in a web page, select the downloaded PDF. The attachment list refers to the document source shown above.

helpPrivacy.message: Processing takes place locally. The main document and the Edge viewer are not modified. For web PDFs, only the document URL is requested.

helpLimits.message: Prepared copies remain in your Downloads folder. PDFs and individual attachments may each be up to 100 MB; all attachments combined may be up to 200 MB.
